tools.name: search
tools.description: Browse products by text, category or filters, with each product's best price. action: search (filters, sort), trending, most_searched (a country's top queries), rows (home-page rows).

tools.name: product
tools.description: Where one product is cheapest today. action: find (from text, model, EAN or URL), get (by slug), variants (sizes, colours), history (daily lowest price), abroad (cheaper in another country).

tools.name: deals
tools.description: action: daily = biggest verified price drops of the last 24 h at rated shops; coupons = valid coupon codes and promotions of compared shops.

tools.name: digital
tools.description: Monthly prices of digital services from official price lists. action: compare (AI chat, streaming, music, VPN, cloud, office...), api_costs (AI API cost for a usage), history (plan price changes).

tools.name: telecom
tools.description: Sourced price lists, in preparation. action: internet (home internet by country, technology, speed, price) or mobile (tariffs by operator, data, commitment).

tools.name: energy
tools.description: Compare offers (compare, from_bill), unit_prices, history, suppliers, appliance (running cost) and fixation alerts (watch, watch_status, watch_confirm, watch_cancel). Indicative, not verified.

tools.name: insurance
tools.description: Information comparison of insurance kinds and insurers: what to compare besides price, with sources. No premiums, no ranking, no recommendation; Fordeal is not an intermediary.

tools.name: shops
tools.description: action: list (compared shops with ratings), then for a shop joining: check_feed, register, status, verify_domain, diagnostics; mine and statistics need the owner's sign-in.

tools.name: price_watch
tools.description: Alert when a product's total drops below a target. Without account: watch (e-mail), status, manage via the mail link token t. Signed in: list, set, update, delete.

tools.name: favorites
tools.description: Needs the person's access token. action: list, add or remove a favourite product or digital plan.

tools.name: comparisons
tools.description: Needs the person's access token. action: list, save (2-4 plans), share (by link) or delete a saved comparison of digital plans.

tools.name: lists
tools.description: Needs the person's access token. action: list, create, update, delete a named list; add or remove a product or digital plan in it.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: Needs the person's access token. action: profile (read), update (name, language, market, watch e-mails), sign_out, delete (permanent, needs confirm).

tools.name: contact
tools.description: action: message (a question, support, privacy request), cooperation (partners, media, creators), issue (wrong price, variant, category, shop), illegal (report illegal content, DSA).

tools.name: help
tools.description: Full documentation of any tool: arguments, rules, examples. topic: overview (default), a tool name, or an old tool name (deprecated, still works). Same text as fordeal://docs/<topic>.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: product · Private data: price_watch, favorites, comparisons, lists, my_account, contact · Public sink: comparisons · Destructive: price_watch, favorites, comparisons, lists, my_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: product · Private data: price_watch, favorites, comparisons, lists, my_account, contact · Public sink: comparisons · Destructive: price_watch, favorites, comparisons, lists, my_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
